GREEN-LIGHT ROSTER (never-probed parks), built 2026-09-01 by NV. METHOD: parsed all 877 attempt records under memory_graph/records/**, dropped the 363 superseded ids, kept live records with outcome parked/capped/negative that have NO attributes.probed_form, NO attributes.axis_log, and a law_screen/scope explicitly stating no source probe was run (regex over 'no source probe|no source change|read-only measurement|label correction only|no edit'). That yields 110 NEVER-PROBED live parks -- i.e. 110 functions whose park records are pure read-only diagnoses, the exact signature that hid fn_8004DB3C (attempt.DE_fn-8004db3c-combined-disjunction-exact.20260901.v1). The attempt.mp-label-correction.* family (114 records) is the bulk of the population, as predicted. 25 fall in TUs owned by other lanes this run (pb_window, movieplayer, items, pb_frame, dcsdrv, memcard, shop, gauntworld, enemy.c, camera) and were excluded, leaving 84 candidates, EVERY ONE REMEASURED with fndiff --count against the current green build (98.21% fuzzy / 62.94% matched); no number here is quoted from a record.

CORRECTION #1 (important, cost-saving for future sweeps): five roster members read real 0 / OK and look stale-solved, but are WEBFRANK-PINNED and therefore real 0 BY CONSTRUCTION -- fndiff scores the postprocessed object. Their source is FROZEN and they are NOT green lights: assign_controller and do_vibe (game/game/controls), pbObjTexSub (game/pb/pb_objects), getNewPosRectShare and MBPsysSetDebugNode (game/mb/mb_particle). Any sweep that ranks never-probed parks by measured real MUST screen config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json first or it will burn probes on frozen source.

CORRECTION #2: ProcessCritterList carries TWO live never-probed parks (the mp-label-correction one and attempt.processcritterlist-zero-remat-law-screen-park.20260901.v1) that never superseded each other; both describe the same measured state (T49/O50 real 25).
